caption: The video captures a dark-green patio umbrella on a central pole before snow-covered trees in a wintry forest. At the start, a tall rounded snow mound covers much of the canopy while flakes and larger clumps drift through the foreground and background. Throughout, the bulk of the snow breaks apart and falls from the upper surface, moving downward and outward. The umbrella appears to remain roughly in place against the trees, while the visible motion is mostly snow leaving it. As chunks separate, they appear as distinct white objects falling past the green fabric, revealing its radial ribs. Small flakes continue, and scattered clumps still rest along the rim and edge while others drift away. By the end, a thinner flatter crust remains on top, while the clearing continues across the canopy.
relations: Instability of the tall snow mound causes it to break apart and fall, revealing the green ribs.
Separating chunks fall past the fabric, leaving a thinner flatter crust on the upper surface.
Scattered clumps persist along the rim while the central bulk clears away during the downward motion.
The umbrella remains stationary against the snowy trees as continuous flakes drift through the foreground.
